farm_name: Northern Lights Elk Ranch of Alaska

feeding_claim.verbatim: Our pasture raised chickens are raised totally outdoors from the moment they leave the brooder to the time we harvest.

availability.note: Eggs show out of stock, 2026 chickens are sold out, and turkey orders are paused for 2026.

notes: Elk ranch in Palmer run by the Cook family that also sells eggs, chicken and turkeys. Read the farm fresh eggs page, egg product page, chicken, turkey, elk meat, about and contact pages on 2026-11-23; homepage not read. Eggs $8 a dozen, pickup local to Palmer; hens forage on pasture in summer. Chickens raised outdoors on grass, one batch no corn or soy; turkeys on pasture with supplemental feed. The ranch also sells elk meat by the quarter and guided elk hunts; elk is not an allowed species and is left out. Turkey page both says orders are paused and that Thanksgiving orders are being taken; Verifier should recheck. Contact page lists a second phone with a 630 area code. Quotes came from WebFetch extraction.
